subject: Verizon Small Cell Wireless Infrastructure Applications
overview: The committee held hearings on 18 applications for 5G small cell installations on utility poles, approving 17 with standard and site-specific conditions. One application was withdrawn by Verizon following committee concerns regarding ADA sidewalk accessibility.

items.title: Call to Order and Legal Purview
items.summary: The chair called the meeting to order and detailed the committee's limited regulatory scope under FCC rulings, noting that health impacts cannot be considered in the review process.

items.title: Verizon Presentation and Health Safety Overview
items.summary: Verizon representatives presented the technical requirements for 5G ultra-wideband infrastructure and provided scientific testimony regarding the safety of non-ionizing radiofrequency emissions.

items.title: Non-Site Specific Public Comment
items.summary: Members of the public raised concerns regarding noise from equipment fans, equitable coverage distribution across the city, and notification procedures for residents near installation sites.

items.title: Establishment of General Conditions
items.summary: The committee established ten general conditions for all approvals, including requirements for insurance certificates, noise restrictions, ADA compliance measurements, and restoration of ground surfaces.

items.title: Yale Street, Brookside Parkway, West Street, and 39 Charnwood Road
items.summary: Approved four applications with general conditions, noting existing city assets and approximate distances to nearby dwellings.

items.title: 48 Clark Street
items.summary: Approved with a site-specific condition requiring a pole extension to a minimum height of 33.33 feet to meet committee safety preferences.

items.title: 18 Fleming Street
items.summary: Verizon withdrew the application after the committee determined the existing pole location obstructed the ADA-accessible path on a driveway apron.

items.title: 24 Pearl Street, 26 Royal Street, 40 Ashland Street, and 23 Woodrow Avenue
items.summary: Approved four applications with conditions including base cleanup, double pole removal, and the installation of a new one-way sign on Royal Street.

items.title: 163 Forest Street, 199 Forest Street, and 12 Fulton Street
items.summary: Approved three applications with site-specific requirements for new street signage, expansion joints at the base, and the investigation of abandoned risers.

items.title: 123 Grant Avenue, Logan Avenue, 83 Washington Street, and 59 Jerome Street
items.summary: Approved the final four applications with conditions for site restoration and the replacement of existing safety and street signage.

items.title: Administrative Finalization
items.summary: The committee authorized the chair to draft and file the formal written decisions for the approved applications.
